tasks.subject: Fix re-dispatch for completed/failed items
tasks.description: The dispatch endpoint only recovers in_progress items. Need to allow re-dispatching from completed/failed states too. Reset agent fields and move to pending before dispatching.

tasks.subject: Auto-detect agent completion and move card
tasks.description: Agent finished (posted GH comment) but item stayed in_progress. Need auto-completion detection — either poll agent-status and auto-move to completed, or check in the dispatch endpoint.

tasks.subject: Add dashboard filtering and pagination
tasks.description: Add filter tabs (All / Pending / In Progress / Completed / Failed) to dashboard. Completed tab should filter to last 7 days by default. Add pagination when queue has many items (e.g. 20 per page).
